summary_1line: Sumantra summons Rama to King Dasharatha; Rama departs with Lakshmana in a grand chariot amid public celebration, expecting his coronation.

image_candidates.scene_text: Rama sits beside Sita on a golden couch while Sumantra bows before him in the richly adorned chamber.
Rama’s gem‑inlaid chariot with tiger skins thunders through Ayodhya as citizens shower flowers from balconies.
Lakshmana stands behind Rama in the speeding chariot holding a chamara while crowds shout victory on both sides.
